provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: A dependency graph in levels with edges from dependency to dependent.
use_when: Explain what depends on what and what a change reaches.
not_when: Cycles; more than eight nodes, four levels or four nodes per level.

parameters.nodes: 3-8 of {label <= 14, level 0-3, contiguous levels, <= 4 per level}
parameters.edges: 2-10 of {from, to} with from at a lower level

limits: Edge curves are not routed around nodes; keep levels tidy. Highlight marks one node and its edges.
